# Cribrum - v2.2.0

Candidate preparation; unpublished.

Cribrum adds multiple claims per case and local response classification. Review,
inventory filters, saved views, statistics and exports use the same claim ledger.
Existing cases, manual assessments, screenshots and reflected-XSS exports remain
compatible through an additive migration.

The classifier reads bounded, private HTTP/DOM observations from existing browser
runs. It records pack versions and evidence spans and suggests observations or
suspicions; SQLi/LFI/RFI are not automatically confirmed. Manual assessment remains
authoritative. Reports distinguish observation, suspicion and confirmation and
exclude private HTTP artifacts unless explicitly selected.

Local diagnostics explain stored and current classification without target
requests. Status and Settings expose packs and storage policy. Reclassification
preserves manual decisions and immutable historical results. Backup listing,
explicit retention previews, private-rulepack snapshots, storage auditing and
read-only upgrade permission checks support operations. Update information
separates version comparison from unverified installation origin.

Follow [the upgrade guide](../../README.md#upgrade-an-existing-workspace) and
[backup instructions](../../BACKUP.md). Upgrade the application and workers together;
keep the database, artifacts and any private rulepacks from the same workspace.

Release acceptance must include cold installation and upgrade from published
2.1.1. C10 shortcut/performance/everyday-use work is outside this implementation
pass; its release disposition remains open. Private-corpus acceptance and backup
measurements on a representative private workspace remain open. This file is
preparation only and does not certify publication or completion of those items.
